title: Zweite Verordnung zur Änderung der Soldatenarbeitszeitverordnung vom 23. September 2022 (BGBl. 2022 I Nr. 34, S. 1533), excerpt: preamble, Art. 4 (§ 1(2) and the 41-row Anlage), Art. 6 and signature
verified_how: curl was answered with an HTML shell that needs JavaScript (no PDF). The text was read on 2026-11-02 in a Chrome session that the repository owner (Meng Wong) directed Claude to drive; the gazette text is the PDF's own text layer as returned by the viewer's pdf.js, read column by column; only the annex's name column was transcribed. The browser's own download did not complete, so the PDF/page was NOT saved to disk and this file is the encoder's transcription of what the browser returned; it has not been compared with the original. Commons guide §8 treats a bot challenge as a 'no'; a browser read was used here with the owner's agreement, and whether that is acceptable under the guide is for Michael to say.
notes: German is the only authoritative language; any English in the encoding is a gloss.
